scope: Native A2A task status projection and selected continuation for simultaneous sibling human questions.
behavior: tasks/get exposes each pending question as a status-message part with xmind.human_request_id metadata.
message/send requires metadata.xmind.human_request_id when multiple questions are pending.
Ambiguous and stale selectors are rejected without admitting the A2A message.
A selected answer wakes the same root task; unanswered siblings remain pending for the next pause.
Retrying a committed message returns the same task and does not answer the question twice.

build.command: & 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\Common7\IDE\CommonExtensions\Microsoft\CMake\CMake\bin\cmake.exe' --build build/native --config Release --target agentflow_dynamic_plan_engine_contract xmind -- /m:8

contracts.name: native_dynamic_plan_engine_contract
contracts.notes: Exercises A2aTaskControl dispatch, status metadata, ambiguous/stale rejection, selected sibling continuation, retry identity, and the next durable pause using actual AgentService and xlang3/SQLite. Provider replies are synthetic.

limits: No live external A2A peer interoperability test exercises the xMind metadata selector.
Continuation of arbitrary messages into an active provider turn remains unsupported.
